Record Type: Zoning Certificate Class I Home Occupation
Description: Cropia Global LLC is a single-member agricultural commodities trading company engaged in the wholesale export of California-grown almonds to wholesale distributors in the United Arab Emirates and broader MENA region. The business serves as an intermediary between California almond growers and established overseas buyers, coordinating supply chain logistics, trade finance, and international sales agreements. All business activity conducted from the home address is purely administrative in nature and consists of: correspondence via email and telephone with suppliers and buyers, preparation of trade and shipping documentation, market research, financial planning, and coordination with freight forwarders and logistics providers. No goods are stored, handled, received, or shipped from the residential address. No customers, clients, or business associates visit the home. No employees or contractors work from or visit the premises. No signage is displayed. No alterations to the residence are required or planned. Physical business activity — such as visiting almond growers and suppliers — takes place at farm and warehouse locations in agricultural regions of California (Fresno, Sacramento Valley, Los Angeles area). All export shipments originate directly from supplier or port facilities, never from the home address. The business has no walk-in traffic, generates no noise, odor, or visual impact, and does not alter the residential character of the property or neighborhood in any way.
